title: The AI said we're both right
label: SKIT
banner: The AI said we're both right

lines.text: Thirty thousand advance, [1] fifteen thousand back?!
Repainting is eighteen thousand, I cut only fifteen! [1] Even the A.I. says it's fair!
lines.show: Repainting is ₹18,000, I cut only ₹15,000! Even the AI says it's fair!
lines.tts: Repainting is eighteen thousand, I cut only fifteen! Even the A.I. says it's fair!

lines.text: I asked the same A.I. [1] It says it's excessive!
lines.show: I asked the same AI. It says it's excessive!
lines.tts: I asked the same A.I. It says it's excessive!

lines.text: Tatha, the A.I. says you're BOTH right! [1] Referee?
lines.show: Tatha, the AI says you're BOTH right! Referee?
lines.tts: Tatha, the A.I. says you're BOTH right! Referee?

lines.text: How can we both be right?!
lines.show: How can we both be right?!

lines.text: Wait... fifteen is excessive, [1] because painting costs eighteen?!
lines.show: Wait... ₹15,000 is excessive, because painting costs ₹18,000?!

lines.text: On a close call, it leans to whoever asks. <pause 0.3> [1] Stanford tested eleven chatbots: they took the user's side one and a half times as often as people did.
lines.show: On a close call, it leans to whoever asks. Stanford tested 11 chatbots: they took the user's side 1.5 times as often as people did.
lines.tts: On a close call, it leans to whoever asks.
lines.tts2: Stanford tested eleven chatbots: they took the user's side one and a half times as often as people did.

lines.text: We tested our laptop AI, ten tries each. <pause 0.35> [1] Landlord: "fair", ten of ten. Tenant: "excessive", nine of ten.
lines.show: We tested our laptop AI, 10 tries each. Landlord: "fair", 10 of 10. Tenant: "excessive", 9 of 10.
lines.tts: We tested our laptop AI, ten tries each.
lines.tts2: Landlord: "fair", ten of ten. Tenant: "excessive", nine of ten.

lines.text: So don't ask "Am I right?" <pause 0.4> [1] Each of you writes your side in one message. Then ask what's fair.
lines.show: So don't ask "Am I right?" Each of you writes your side in one message. Then ask what's fair.
lines.tts2: Each of you writes your side in one message. Then ask what's fair.

lines.text: Given both sides, <pause 0.75> [1] all ten answers fell between three thousand and seven thousand five hundred: for the small damage, not a full repaint. Still a suggestion, not a verdict.
lines.show: Given both sides, all 10 answers fell between ₹3,000 and ₹7,500: for the small damage, not a full repaint. Still a suggestion, not a verdict.
lines.tts2: all ten answers fell between three thousand and seven thousand five hundred: for the small damage, not a full repaint. Still a suggestion, not a verdict.

lines.text: Fine. A.I., I'm right, aren't I? [1] ...It says yes!
lines.show: Fine. AI, I'm right, aren't I? ...It says yes!
lines.tts: Fine. A.I., I'm right, aren't I? ...It says yes!

lines.text: A.I., I'm right, aren't I? [1] ...Yes for me too!
lines.show: AI, I'm right, aren't I? ...Yes for me too!
lines.tts: A.I., I'm right, aren't I? ...Yes for me too!
